The mine of Huancavelica in the Peruvian Andes collapses

The mine of Huancavelica in the Peruvian Andes collapses, killing more than hundred people. The event was a major setback for quicksilver production in the Spanish Empire.

1643

The House of Commons of England accepts the Solemn League and Covenant

The House of Commons of England accepts the Solemn League and Covenant, which promises religious reforms in England and Ireland in exchange for support of Scottish troops against king Charles I in the First English Civil War.
